title: Quorint: Bridge Relaunch Security Review + 6-Month Attack Registry, Economic Attack Simulator & Upgrade Audits (Roadmap Track 6 P3, Track 5 P1/P2)
summary: Funds a 24-week security engagement with Quorint (https://quorint.xyz): an independent security review for the Gonka-Ethereum bridge relaunch after the 18 November 2026 incident (Roadmap Track 6 P3), an executable attack registry (Track 5 P1), an economic attack simulator (Track 5 P2) and pre-mainnet upgrade audits. Allocates 1,600,000 GNK from the Community Pool (no USDT) to a new instance of the code_id 107 milestone escrow used by Proposal #82 (escrow gonka1m5gr4pkemg7fyml3jlkecpvxzprrkglfu05jfe8kmm38780ajp5s9qznhg, no admin, no migration), paying Quorint (gonka1ggt0d4jqmztnmh86na3m99c9d3q7s6h2dkd2qv) in six tranches on days 0, 45, 90, 135, 180 and 210: 250,000 / 300,000 / 300,000 / 300,000 / 250,000 / 200,000 GNK. A public milestone report is due 5 days before each unlock. Governance can claw back everything still in the escrow with one vote; after day 270 anyone can sweep the remainder to the Community Pool. Full commit-pinned proposal: https://github.com/quorint/gonka-security-proposal/blob/dec028b64bd5ec09db2b2a26b858610b1ffd0dfb/README.md
